versions.changelog:
firecrawl-agent v1.0.0

- Initial release of firecrawl-agent skill for AI-powered structured data extraction from complex, multi-page websites.
- Supports autonomous navigation and JSON output with user-provided schemas.
- Command-line options include targeted URLs, model selection, schema input, credit limits, and output formatting.
- Recommended for extracting pricing tiers, product lists, directories, and similar structured content across websites.
